items.translation: 基于 Map 的RequestedContentTypeResolverBuilder.ParameterResolverConfigurer.mediaType(String, MediaType)变体。

items.source: RequestedContentTypeResolver strategy and implementations to resolve the requested content type for a given request.
items.translation: RequestedContentTypeResolver 策略和实现，用于解析给定请求的请求内容类型。

items.source: Configure a mapping between a lookup key (extracted from a query parameter value) and a corresponding MediaType.
items.translation: 配置一个映射，将查找键（从查询参数值中提取）与相应的MediaType对应起来。

items.source: Set the name of the parameter to use to determine requested media types.
items.translation: 将参数名称设置为用于确定请求媒体类型的参数。

items.source: Add a resolver to get the requested content type from a query parameter.
items.translation: 添加一个解析器，从查询参数中获取请求的内容类型。
